description.value: A cross-sectional study examined whether FTO obesity-risk genotype was associated with food intake and brain responses to visual food cues before and after a standardized meal.

spans.text: We performed a cross-sectional study in a sample that was enriched for obesity and included 20 higher-risk participants with the AA (risk) genotype at the rs9939609 locus of FTO and 94 lower-risk participants with either the AT or TT genotype.
